## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感。列表页新的筛选和排序部件（可搜索的字段清单、按字段类型选值、视图栏下的条件标签行）先合进代码，第二步接到列表上以后才会出现。
- 为什么做：属于「列表页重做」专题的筛选和排序两张子卡。您要求按参照产品重做筛选和排序的过程，席位定为两步：这一步只合不改变行为的部件。
- 出错会怎样：这一步没有任何页面用到这些部件，出错不影响现在的列表，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

This is step 1 of 2, ruled by the seat in claim amendment 7017578497 on the filter card. It adds components and locale keys only. **No list mounts them yet, so this PR changes no behaviour.** Step 2 wires them in.

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/FieldList.tsx`: **the shared field list.** It has a search box over label and name, the fields the view shows first (in column order), then the hidden ones, a type icon on each row, and ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter. Filter and sort both use it, and the options card can reuse it.
- `FilterValuePanel.tsx`: one condition's values, by field type.
  - Option field: a coloured multi-pick, default operator `in`.
  - Lookup: the existing `LookupValuePicker`.
  - Text: `contains`, sent 250 ms after the last keystroke.
  - Number: at least / at most / equals / between.
  - Date: four of the spec's `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS` (today, this week, this month, last 30 days) plus a custom range.
  - Boolean: yes / no.

  The operator sits on top and can be changed at any point. Every pick hands the row back at once; there is no Apply.
- `ListConditionControls.tsx`: three controlled components.
  - `FilterPanel`: field list, then values. Its footer opens the host's advanced panel (`renderAdvanced`, today's `FilterBuilder`, unchanged). An OR group opens the advanced panel directly.
  - `SortPanel`: the direction on top, then the field list. One click adds a level, or sets the direction of a level that already exists.
  - `ConditionChipRow`: sort chips first (a click reverses, a drag or Alt+Arrow reorders, × removes). Then the view's own conditions as locked chips with no ×. Then the reader's filter chips (a click reopens the values, × removes). Then 「Add filter」 and 「Reset」. It renders `null` when it has nothing to show, so the host's slot keeps `empty:hidden`.
- `conditionModel.ts`: pure helpers. `conditionTranslations.ts`: a safe-translation hook with literal keys.
- The 11 locale packs gain a `listConditions` namespace. `zh-Hant.ts` is generated by `gen:zh-hant`.
- One allowlist line in `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts`: `listConditions.chips.pattern` (`{{field}}: {{value}}`) is a format string and reads the same in ko/ru/ar. The precedent is `console.assignedWork.failure`.
- The changeset is `@object-ui/i18n` patch only. `@object-ui/plugin-list` ships nothing new: after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list build`, `dist` has 0 files with `condition-chips` / `listConditions.`, while the positive control `toolbar-filter-trigger` hits 2.

No storage-format, `uf_*` or server-sort change. A quick filter writes ordinary `FilterBuilderRowGroup` rows. A sort chip edits the same `SortItem[]` that the column header writes.

### Step 2 (separate PR, after the list-frame card lands)

Branch `claude/issue-35549-list-filter-sort-wiring` carries `Fixes` for both cards and contains:

- In `ListView.tsx`, only at the list-frame card's `list-condition-row` slot and the Filter/Sort trigger targets:
  - the 「Filter」 popover opens `FilterPanel`, with today's `FilterBuilder` behind its 「Advanced filter」 footer and its props unchanged;
  - the 「Sort」 popover opens `SortPanel`;
  - `ConditionChipRow` fills the slot. Its 「Reset」 covers filter and sort only. The 「Personalized」 badge stays as it is.
- Migration of the existing filter/sort popover tests. Expected, not measured: ListView `filterFieldList-11810`, `filterDatePicker-12743`, `filterFieldRead-11925`, `storedRuleDialect-11533`, `sortFieldRead-11943`, `sortRemovableOnly-11943`, `relationalSort`, `sortFieldFallback`, `sortPersistLeak`, `restoreViewDefaults-28948`, `headerSort`, `phoneSortSearch-28911`, `toolbarRows-27520`, `toolbarAccessibleNames-12500`, `toolbarIconButtons-12695`, `emptyStateClearFilters-28908`, `personalization-28950`; live e2e `user-filters`, `saved-view-filter`.
- The platform-checklist filter and sort items.
- Dropping the advanced panel's 「Where」 label: `filterBuilder.where` is retired and its testKey moves.
- The Playwright geometry/interaction spec `ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts`. It is already written, and it passed 3/3 in Chromium against these components at b356ac5a18. It covers: the CONTROL row takes 0 px; Filter → Stage → Negotiation in 3 clicks with the count going 12 → 3; Sort → Descending → Amount in 3 clicks; a real drag reordering two levels; Reset.

Header-click sort needs no grid change. `handleHeaderSort` already writes `currentSort`, which the chips read.

## Tests

Tests migrated or retired: none in this PR, since nothing existing changes behaviour; the list for step 2 is above. Platform-checklist items edited: none in this PR; step 2 edits them.

New file: `plugin-list/src/conditions/__tests__/listConditions.test.tsx`, with 28 tests. Each acceptance item is a test:
- From the trigger, a stage filter takes 3 clicks, and two stages take 4.
- The group goes up on each pick, and an unfinished row is held back.
- The chip reads 「Stage: Negotiation, Proposal」, reopens its values ticked, and × removes it.
- View conditions are locked chips with no button.
- No 「Where」 or 「其中」 appears.
- Sort: from the trigger, amount descending takes 3 clicks; the direction is worded by type; a drag reorders two levels; Reset is disabled while the list matches the view.
- CONTROL: the row renders nothing.

<details><summary>Test and type-check readings at 7892cab41a</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/ packages/i18n/src/__tests__/` gave `Test Files 105 passed (105)`, `Tests 1984 passed | 13 skipped (1997)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` both exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the 6 `src/conditions` files.
- Ablation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0), and each restore matched the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - (a) The panel never hands the row up: vitest 5 failed.
  - (b) The empty-row `return null` is turned off: vitest 2 failed (CONTROL and the unfinished row).
  - (c) The sort drag is a no-op: vitest 1 failed.

  The same three mutations each turned the Playwright spec red as well (2, 3 and 1 failed).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- In this PR the components are unreachable from any page, so there is nothing to see in the Console yet.
- The seat ratified the five extra files under `conditions/` (claim amendment 7017578497).
- Head 1636c1c2d5 has 7892cab41a's tree byte for byte (`git diff 7892cab41a 1636c1c2d5` is empty). It reverts e5ee237064 and 620ea09619, the field-list manager props for the Options → Fields card, which move to a stacked PR so this one stays under the 3,000-line line. The readings below were taken on that same tree.

## Verification

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ListConditionControls.tsx` (`FilterPanel.commit`): a row reaches the host only once it filters, and is removed when its last value goes.
2. `conditionModel.ts` (`readViewConditions`): which shapes of the view's own filter become locked chips.
3. `FilterValuePanel.tsx` (`DateValues`): the date windows are the spec preset macros, not invented ones.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/` should end with `Tests 28 passed (28)`.

<details><summary>Gates at 7892cab41a</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 40 families. All 40 ran locally and exited 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 「40 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)」.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exited 0 with `VERDICT clean`. It merges cleanly with `origin/main` and with #35615 (the list-frame PR, which shares the 11 locale files).
- The merged tree's `zh-Hant.ts` equals the generator's output from the merged `zh-Hans.ts`.
</details>
